official_metadata.official_description: Snow-covered skyscraper rooftops featuring mechanical penthouses, rooftop HVAC units, elevated helipads, connecting utility ziplines, and vertical maintenance shafts connecting multi-tier roof decks.
official_metadata.provenance: Activision / Infinity Ward Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Official Intel

cut_the_cake_suitability.analysis_notes: Cut the Cake Inference: Pure 2D planar projection breaks down due to distinct multi-tier roof decks and zipline connections. Canonical benchmark case study for Milestone 6 (2.5D elevation layers).
